rules.title: Organise your evidence
rules.purpose: Make the complaint facts and supporting documents easy to review.
rules.action: Gather order confirmation, payment proof, photos/video if relevant, and previous messages.
rules.caveat: Starter placeholder. Verify exact guidance and replace with a specific official source before relying on it.

rules.title: Contact the platform or seller
rules.purpose: Give the company a clear written record of the issue and requested outcome.
rules.action: Prepare a factual complaint with order details and evidence; user sends it themselves.
rules.caveat: Do not display a statutory countdown until the exact legal provision is verified.

rules.title: Consider National Consumer Helpline
rules.purpose: Find the official consumer grievance channel and understand its process.
rules.action: Open the official NCH portal and follow its current instructions.
rules.caveat: Confirm current contacts, hours, and scope on the official portal before displaying details.

rules.title: Review consumer commission filing information
rules.purpose: If earlier steps do not resolve the issue, review official filing information.
rules.action: Read current e-Jagriti guidance and consider getting qualified advice before filing.
rules.caveat: Starter placeholder. Do not infer jurisdiction, fees, documents, or limitation periods from this entry.
